title: Turkey and Cumin Quesadillas
blurb: Spiced turkey with fresh cilantro and red onion in crisp tortillas, served with avocado and a squeeze of lemon.
steps: Finely chop the red onion and coriander, slice the turkey breast thinly, and cut the red pepper into thin strips.
Grate the cheese and set aside with the turkey, onion, pepper and half the coriander.
Lay the tortillas flat and divide the cheese, turkey, onion and pepper over one half of each tortilla, then sprinkle with the cumin.
Fold each tortilla in half to enclose the filling and press down gently.
Heat the olive oil in a large frying pan over medium heat and cook the quesadillas for two to three minutes each side until golden and the cheese has melted.
Halve and stone the avocado, scoop out the flesh and slice it.
Cut each quesadilla into wedges and serve topped with avocado slices, the remaining coriander and a squeeze of lemon juice.
